race.comment: HIGHLAND KITTY (6) has the right blend of current form and course substance. She was beaten just under a length in a CL1 here last start after jumping awkwardly and racing wide early, and the Ipswich Mdn win before that was arrogant.  Is yet to miss the frame over this track and trip from four starts and gets in well again with the claimer sticking. Another bold showing is anticipated. AUTUMN HEIR (5) was beaten just over half a length in a country BM58 after home-straight interference and had also gone close at Muswellbrook. Tougher this time but gets weight relief and a key booking in Thompson.  LARUSSO (1) backs up from a solid Gold Coast fourth and has been knocking on the door for a while. Has his first look at this trip on the quick back-up and doesn't need to improve much to land the winning blow. POOR OL' JOHNY RAY (2) had excuses in a BM70 here last start, then drops back into a more suitable race with a prior Mdn win at this venue giving him a solid rebound platform.
